description: Source code for the Opencart Cheque payment extension controller, defining the Cheque class with methods for displaying the payment form and processing the confirmation.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for handling Cheque payment method, extending the core Controller class. Contains methods for rendering the payment form and processing order confirmation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, retrieves configuration data for 'payable', 'address', and 'language', and returns the rendered view for the Cheque payment form.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation of a Cheque payment, performs validation checks, adds order history, and returns a JSON response with success or error message.
